sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Identify the correct article to fill in the blank: Riya saw ___ old stag standing near the river.
Based on the story 'The Old Stag', what was the stag most proud of?
Which of the following is an abstract noun?
Who invented the special reading and writing system for visually impaired people in the chapter 'Braille'?
Choose the correct verb to complete the sentence: The team of players ___ practicing on the field.
According to the chapter 'Be Smart Be Safe', what is the safest thing to do before crossing a road?
options: A) Run as fast as you can
B) Close your eyes and walk
C) Look left, right, and left again
D) Listen to loud music on headphones
questions.answer: C) Look left, right, and left again

options: C) Hiding is the best option

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: What moral lesson do we learn from the poem 'One Thing at a Time'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The poem advises us to focus completely on a single task to complete it successfully. Doing many things at the same time often ruins all the work.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following sentence correctly using a possessive noun: 'The bags belonging to the students are kept in the classroom.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The students' bags are kept in the classroom. This correctly shows possession by placing an apostrophe after the plural noun that ends with the letter 's'.

questions.question_text: Based on the chapter 'Braille', explain how the Braille system helps visually impaired people read books. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Braille system uses unique patterns of raised dots on thick paper. Visually impaired people read by gently feeling these raised dots with their fingertips from left to right.

questions.question_text: Identify the main verb and the helping verb in this sentence: 'She is writing a letter to her grandmother.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: In this sentence, the helping verb is 'is' and the main verb is 'writing'. Together, they form the present continuous tense, showing an action happening right now.

questions.question_text: Why did the old stag regret being proud of his beautiful horns at the end of the story? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The stag was very proud of his beautiful horns, but they got tangled in the bushes and trapped him. His thin legs, which he hated, were what actually helped him run.

questions.question_text: Imagine you see a younger child playing dangerously near an open street drain. Applying lessons from 'Be Smart Be Safe', what would you explain to them? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would gently tell them to step away immediately because open drains are deep and slippery. I would explain that playing near roads or drains can cause serious accidents and injuries. Finally, I would guide them to play in a safe community park instead.

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing your favorite festival. You must strictly include at least one declarative, one interrogative, and one exclamatory sentence. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Diwali is my absolute favorite festival! It brings so much joy and bright light to everyone's life. We decorate our entire house with beautiful clay lamps. Do you know why we celebrate it? It marks the grand victory of light over darkness and good over evil!

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Based on the theme of 'Together We Can', describe a time when you and your friends worked together to solve a difficult problem. How did teamwork help? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Once, our class had to clean the huge school garden for Earth Day. It looked impossible for just one person. We divided the work—some collected dry leaves, others watered the plants, and a few arranged the pots. By working as a team, we finished the difficult task quickly and easily!

questions.question_text: Expand the following simple idea into a short, descriptive story using correct pronouns: 'A boy found a lost puppy. The boy took the puppy home.' [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Rahul was walking home from school when he found a shivering little puppy hiding under a wooden bench. He gently picked it up and wrapped it in his warm winter jacket. When he reached home, his mother gave the puppy some warm milk. They eventually adopted it and named him Max.
